verdict.rationale: First-party material describes a built-in AI assistant that takes plain-language requests to create, categorize, tag, approve and reject expenses, configure workspaces and rules, and answer account questions with charts. The Concierge agent also auto-submits reports on a timeline. One older community comment claims Concierge support replies were human-powered, but it describes support response times rather than a failure of the current AI task-delegation features, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the AI assistant reliably performs delegated tasks, and in-depth docs on its scope and limits beyond marketing blog posts.
